# Full package list of the training environment used for the paper (Python 3.12.12), generated with
# "pip list --format=freeze" and re-checked against public PyPI (2026-09-28). Use it as a constraints file:
#
#   pip install -r env/requirements-train.txt -c env/constraints-train.txt
#
# Changes from the raw freeze: the editable installs of this repository's miles fork and of SGLang are replaced
# (miles is installed from ./miles; SGLang by its PyPI release built from the same tag), local "+cu130" labels are
# dropped (they still match the wheels from the PyTorch cu130 index), two leftover CUDA 12 pins from an earlier torch
# build are commented out (one of them, nvidia-cudnn-cu12, overwrote torch's cuDNN library; see env/install.md), and one
# entry that torch's cuda-toolkit dependency pins exactly is omitted.
# Many entries are optional extras that SGLang's "[all]" install pulled in; they are harmless as constraints because a
# constraint only applies to a package that something else requires.
